summary:
Five map-pin pages translated, one output file each, no merging. All five treated as real translation work per the brief.

MEASURED, not assumed: I re-ran the overlap myself against the Hope's Last Day chunk that actually contains these rooms — ST-J08 (whose h3 list is Operations / Medlab / Stasis Room / Surgery Room / Morgue / Station Maintenance Center / Life Support/Power + the events). Split into sentences >15 chars, 43/43 = 100.0% of my units' prose appears VERBATIM inside ST-J08.en.html. So the group-3 five happen to sit entirely inside the overlapping subset — the 60.8% figure and the three zero-overlap pages (Asset/Claims, Assistant Manager, Geological Managers) live in the OTHER pin groups, not this one. ST-J08.cn.html does not exist yet, so nothing could be reused verbatim; every line here is new and every line is a reconciliation point (see open_issues #1).

Register: GM-facing horror description, not read-aloud — no evblockquoteCenter and no evexamplebox in any of the five, so I wrote for a GM reading at the table, kept the sentences short at the shock beats (破胸体 breaking out, the five bodies coming down), and left the mechanics clauses flat.

Markup: tag-name multisets, class attributes, all style/src/data-* attributes, and the whole @UUID machinery on the one link in ST-J26 are byte-identical to the English. starterset's class="ev-content-link" preserved (not corerules' content-link). The 10 U+00A0 in ST-J27 (one inside the basesymbol span, one either side of it, seven in the evscol2 spacer cells) are preserved exactly, 10 -> 10. The one U+00A0 in ST-J25 was an English word-joiner inside "All PCs" with no Chinese counterpart and was dropped (open_issues #5).

Headings: all six translated headings carry an explicit id= holding the original English slug, per PROJECT.md §1.2 ④ / the register's heading_anchor_hashes remediation. station-maintenance-center is the load-bearing one — it is a live data-hash with 2 occurrences in the pack. tannens-casino is the deliberate exception, see open_issues #2.

Term spine: COMTECH 通信科技 / OBSERVATION 侦察 / 压力等级 / 恐慌检定 / 护甲等级 / 电力 / 电力余量 all byte-match lang/cn.json. Note ST-J23 and ST-J25 carry the skill names WITHOUT strong in the English, so I did not add strong there — only ST-J26 and ST-J27 have them, and there the strong count is 2 and 3 exactly as in the source.

Dash discipline: EN DASH U+2013 kept only where it is a minus sign (–2 骰子, matching the ST-J03 house style); the English's parenthetical – became —— in Chinese, as ST-J02/ST-J03 already do (28 and 20 occurrences). PC is left as "PC" with ASCII spaces, again following ST-J03.

glossary_gaps.proposed: 阿玛特37A2 12号口径泵动霰弹枪

The 《异形RPG：进化版》 ch.2 serial renders it 军用型37A2 12号口径霰弹枪, and mined_fan_translation.json's own note flags that as an ERROR: Armat is the manufacturer, not the adjective 'armed/military', and should transliterate to 阿玛特. open_issues: 1. RECONCILIATION REQUIRED — all five units are 100% shared with ST-J08, and ST-J08.cn.html DID NOT EXIST when I ran. I measured it rather than assuming: sentence-split at >15 chars, 43/43 of my units' sentences appear verbatim inside ST-J08.en.html (J23 10/10, J24 3/3, J25 10/10, J26 10/10, J27 10/10). So the group-3 five sit entirely inside the overlapping subset — the 60.8% figure and the three zero-overlap pages belong to the other pin groups. Nothing could be reused, so the cross-check must force ST-J08's five location sections to come out byte-identical to these files, headings and ids included. If ST-J08's translator picked different room names, MY files are the ones that also have to match the scene note labels, so reconcile toward whichever the note labels use.

2. DELIBERATE DEVIATION, needs a controller ruling — ST-J26's h2 got id="tannens-casino", NOT the true English slug. Foundry's non-strict slugify turns 'Tannen’s Casino' into tannen’s-casino because the apostrophe is U+2019, so the two live data-hash="tannens-casino" anchors in Hope's Last Day resolve to NOTHING today — the register lists it under data_hash_not_resolving_today. I had to write some id, and I chose the one that makes those links work rather than the one that byte-preserves an upstream defect. This REPAIRS an upstream bug, which PROJECT.md §7.3 says is not our job. Revert to id="tannen’s-casino" if strict behaviour preservation is wanted; the same call has to be made in ST-J08, which owns the other copy of this heading.

3. ST-J10 must add id="stage-iii" to its 'Stage III: Chestburster' h3, or my ST-J26 link stays broken. Same root cause: the English heading slugifies to stage-iii:-chestburster, so the data-hash="stage-iii" I copied verbatim resolves to nothing today (2 occurrences, both listed as non-resolving). I could not fix it from inside my unit — the id belongs on the target heading. My label reads 第三阶段：破胸体 and must equal ST-J10's h3 text.

4. ST-J27 says 'the W-Y Manager Office on level 1' but the page/heading is 'Weyland-Yutani Office' (ST-J07) and ST-J21 says 'W-Y Office'. Three spellings of one room. I used 韦汤经理办公室; ST-J07's heading will presumably be 韦兰德-汤谷办公室. Someone should decide whether the short in-text references collapse to the heading form.

5. ST-J25 dropped one U+00A0 — it was an English word-joiner inside 'All PCs' with no Chinese counterpart. All 10 structural NBSPs in ST-J27 are preserved 10→10. No gate counts NBSP (checked apply_translations.py, scan_markup_drift.py, validate_translations.py), so this is a note, not a violation.

6. ST-J24 dropped the & from 'Pauling Surgical & Scanner MedPod', rendering it 鲍林外科与扫描医疗舱. Not markup — markup_signature only tracks &Reference[...] — but flagging since it is an entity that vanished.
7. 'Operations Manager' → 运营经理 is coupled to whatever ST-J08's 'Operations' h3 becomes. If that page picks 指挥中心/作业中心 over 运营, my ST-J25 title should follow.

8. Six item names in the ST-J27 table are the prose face of pack Items whose T-BILINGUAL Chinese halves are decided elsewhere. I used the glossary's no-space Latin+CJK byte-form (M41A脉冲步枪, not M41A 脉冲步枪) so a later term sweep can still grep them, which means the table cells look denser than the surrounding prose where house style spaces Latin runs. Worth a consistency ruling, and worth checking against corerules ch.5 GEAR & TECH, where 39 @UUID{Label} labels are hard sync points for the same names.
